answer: The inlet admits twenty-four anchors per epoch, in a shared twenty-minute window. A claimant drops one anchor seeded by the last block and the anchor before, then keeps its pulse beacon flashing on the block clock; three strangers sign it, two buoys each. Entry locks 70 POA, +50 per extra identity from one root: ten fakes lock 2,950 POA. One operator anchors two at most: ten fakes need five hands, ten drops, thirty signatures from fifteen strangers at once. A missed pulse burns 25; one chain on two buoys voids both. The ledger ties every drop time to its funding root.
